title: BUGFIX — pipeline-watchdog: exclude dry-run posts from gate post count
rationale: scripts/pipeline-watchdog.ts uses manualPosts.length without filtering dry-runs. Stale-alert message reports wrong post count (16 instead of 13). Fix: add DRY_METHODS filter before counting recordedPosts.
